Gentle humor, the robot is content and oblivious. Expressive character, minimal clutter, soft pastel tones, XKCD-inspired infographic style. Suitable for a technical textbook. specs.alt: A blindfolded cartoon robot sorting colored marbles into matching bins by color alone, while a nearby picture frame shows two distant same-blue regions wrongly merged into one and scattered single-color speckles, illustrating how pixel clustering ignores spatial location and produces salt-and-pepper speckle and merged distant regions.
specs.caption: Sort pixels by color alone and you get five tidy shades rather than five objects, plus confetti speckle wherever a stray pixel wanders into the wrong group.

specs.prompt: Simple, cartoon-like educational illustration with clean lines and a warm color palette on a clean white background, generous margins: a small friendly green sprout grows from a single glowing seed planted inside an object, spreading happily across similar neighboring tiles. A cartoon hand turns a tolerance dial one notch too far, and the sprout suddenly surges across a faint, barely-visible boundary and floods over the entire sky, vines spilling everywhere with a comically surprised expression. Gentle humor about overreach. Expressive characters, minimal clutter, soft pastel tones, XKCD-inspired infographic style. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. One clear visual metaphor: region growing leaks across a faint edge and swallows too much when the threshold is set too high.
specs.alt: A friendly green sprout growing from a seed inside an object spreads across similar tiles, but when a hand turns a tolerance dial too far the sprout surges across a faint boundary and floods the whole sky with vines, illustrating the leakage failure of region growing when the homogeneity threshold is set too high.
specs.caption: Nudge the tolerance one notch too far and the region chains across a faint gradient into the next object, swallowing the whole sky: the Magic Wand leak you have already cursed at.

Soft pastel water and earth tones, gentle and whimsical. Expressive character, minimal clutter, XKCD-inspired infographic style. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. specs.alt: A cartoon terrain cross-section with two valleys separated by a ridge, blue water rising to fill each valley as a separate lake while a small engineer character builds a dam on the ridge where the lakes would meet, illustrating the watershed transform flooding catchment basins and placing boundary dams at ridges to separate touching objects.
specs.caption: Read intensity as altitude, flood the valleys from below, and build a dam wherever two rising lakes would merge; those dams are your object boundaries.

Neat, architectural, balanced composition. Expressive character, minimal clutter, soft pastel tones, XKCD-inspired infographic style. Suitable for a technical textbook. No text or lettering in the image. One clear visual metaphor: graph cut wires every pixel to a source and sink and severs the cheapest set of edges.
specs.alt: A grid of pixel-nodes each tied by string to a warm-red source above and a dark sink below, with a surveyor robot snipping the cheapest line of connecting strings to cleanly separate warm-tinted nodes from cool-tinted ones, illustrating the graph-cut construction where the minimum source-to-sink cut is the globally optimal foreground-background boundary.
specs.caption: Wire every pixel to a foreground source and a background sink, then sever the single cheapest set of edges; the result is the globally optimal fence, not merely a locally convenient one.
